verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Bevy as an ECS-based engine with strong rendering/graphics features (2D/3D renderer, UI, animation) but contains no mention of a headless/dedicated-server build mode, MinimalPlugins, or any way to run game logic without rendering. The only code sample shown (bevy-gh-1) uses DefaultPlugins, which bundles rendering rather than demonstrating a headless configuration.
